PASS Time cell synchronizes graph and original messages
PASS Actual SVG heatmap cell filters 24 source messages
PASS Filtered report matches the selected hour and every source message
PASS Actual graph node click and communication without evidence
PASS Nadia selection and URL-encoded identity
PASS Two-hop, community and edge-type filters survive graph-mode changes
PASS Neighborhood context edge reveals all of its messages
PASS Search Boss and The Lookout
PASS First communication source and evidence targets
PASS Copy event ID to the actual browser clipboard
PASS Network drag, zoom and original inferred edges
PASS Mouse-wheel zoom changes the visible network transform
PASS Explain anomaly and follow original IDs
PASS Missing timestamps and original anomalous year
PASS Candidate scores, weights, manual uncertainty and evidence
PASS Empty date range is stable
PASS Export contains all filtered original messages and provenance
PASS Offline report includes source messages, vector views and provenance
PASS Responsive 1366 desktop and runtime errors
redesign: PASS Reopening the same evidence returns to its visible detail
PASS Single-day communication opens exact source text beside the chart
PASS Hour selection keeps fourteen-day context and undo restores scope
PASS Anomaly explanation includes all fourteen same-hour observations
PASS Directed matrix retains every source communication weight
PASS Topic group cells and representative messages use original evidence
PASS Export from a task switch never produces zero-size hidden figures
PASS Candidate feature comparison and Nadia event swimlanes remain auditable
PASS Desktop layouts keep evidence in the viewport and have no page overflow
topic-scope: PASS Selected group count and ranked samples belong to the same official message set
PASS Evidence and topic exports preserve the selected group scope
PASS Selecting a topic header returns to all groups in the current filter
PASS A delayed previous group request cannot overwrite a newer group selection
PASS Changing the topic model clears the previous model selection
PASS Date filtering clears obsolete group membership and reloads scoped samples
PASS Empty scopes do not retain old representatives
investigation: PASS Vessel candidates, original operator roles, evidence and export agree
PASS Switching types clears incompatible candidates and restores Person comparisons
PASS Empty filters clear both candidates and roles without page overflow
PASS Source conflicts and duplicate/nearby communication links retain original evidence
workbench: PASS Event overview covers all filtered events and stays fixed while the list paginates
PASS Small desktop shows linked panels together and maximize returns to the same context
PASS Expanded topic view uses the available width for matrix and original-sample comparison
analysis-tasks: PASS Q1: dense-hour investigation and offline report preserve direction, scope and source text
PASS Q2: topic uncertainty is visible and group selection exports only the selected official records
PASS Q3: Person/Vessel comparison preserves candidate uncertainty and original role evidence
PASS Q4: Nadia event overview and export include every selected event with raw support and time
PASS Event export records local controls and blocks stale-scope export while reloading
reliability: PASS Failed partial refresh blocks export; retry restores a coherent scope
PASS Rapid filters and partial response delays keep the exported report coherent
PASS Visible self-loop opens its six source messages using the keyboard
PASS Eight distinct topic colors, normalized group shares and boundary evidence are inspectable
PASS Report export waits for independently loading visible views
PASS Small-desktop event chart fits the panel width
investigation-quality: PASS Candidate evidence precedes rankings and explains each side with source excerpts
PASS Weight reload preserves the open note editor and its unsaved text
PASS Weight/sample sensitivity and custom periods remain traceable in exports
findings: PASS All four findings restore their scope, retain original messages and export counterarguments and limitations
topic-sampling: PASS All six topics show mathematically closest boundary samples and reproducible reviewed samples within scope
